tools.name: browse_profile
tools.description: Opens a user profile by username in the app profile view. Accepts usernames with or without a leading @ and returns a compact profile summary.

username.description: Username to open in the profile view. A leading @ or a /@username profile URL is accepted.

includeProfileResponse.description: Whether to include the raw api/client/GetProfileInfo response in the tool result. Defaults to false to keep the result compact.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Opens the Create post composer so the user can record a new video, upload an existing video, or upload an image/photo to publish as a post.

tools.name: save_current_post_to_bookmarks
tools.description: Saves the currently active post directly to the signed-in user's Bookmarks collection. This is idempotent: if the current post is already in Bookmarks, it returns success without removing it.

expectedPostId.description: Optional safety guard. If provided, the current post must have this id before it is saved to Bookmarks.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Searches user-published video and image posts by free text. Current version does not run live search; it opens a curated static collection in scrollable mode.

query.description: Free-text search query for posts published by users, including video and image posts. Current version opens a curated static collection instead of running live search.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Sends a direct message to a user profile by username, then opens the resulting message thread in the app. This requires sign-in.

username.description: Username of the profile to send a direct message to. A leading @ or a /@username profile URL is accepted.

includeServerResponse.description: Whether to include the raw api/dm/threads/broadcast send response in the tool result. Defaults to true.

tools.name: show_direct_messages
tools.description: Opens the Threads / direct messages view and returns the api/dm/threads response plus a compact summary so the AI agent can answer questions like whether there are unread DMs or messages today.

includeServerResponse.description: Whether to include the raw api/dm/threads server response in the tool result. Defaults to true so the AI agent can answer questions about threads.

tools.name: show_nearby_on_map
tools.description: Opens the app map and searches a rectangular geographic area for either posts or users, one type at a time. Provide west/south/east/north bounds so the map fits to that area and renders matching nearby items.

itemType.description: Object type to show on the map. Use one type at a time: post or user.

bounds.description: Rectangular search area in geographic coordinates using west,south,east,north bounds.

west.description: Western longitude of the search rectangle.

south.description: Southern latitude of the search rectangle.

east.description: Eastern longitude of the search rectangle.

north.description: Northern latitude of the search rectangle.

label.description: Optional human-readable place label, for example Central Park, New York.
